title: Digital Marketing Executive (Social Media)
description:
FindCore are thrilled to be assisting a leading not-for-profit organisation with the recruitment of a Marketing Executive (Social Media & Content).

The role will be based in Cheadle, Greater Manchester, and will focus on growing organic reach, engagement and income across the organisation's established social media channels.

Salary

£35,000 - £45,000, depending on experience + great benefits.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop engaging social media content across a range of established platforms.
- Help grow organic reach, engagement and income through social media activity.
- Plan and deliver content aligned with wider marketing and fundraising objectives.
- Manage content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X.
- Create and adapt content including short-form video, social copy and campaign assets.
- Monitor performance and use analytics to improve future content and campaigns.
- Support paid social activity where required.
- Work closely with wider digital and fundraising teams on integrated campaigns.
- Identify emerging social media trends and opportunities to grow audiences.
- Use AI and digital tools to support content creation, reporting and campaign development.

Skills & Experience
- 2+ years' experience within social media, content marketing or digital marketing.
- Proven experience growing social media reach and engagement.
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills.
- Good understanding of social media analytics and performance reporting.
- Experience with paid social, SEO or creator content would be beneficial.
- Comfortable using AI-powered content tools as part of the creative process.
- Strong communication, organisation and project-management skills.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.
- Opportunity to join a purpose-led not-for-profit organisation.
- Varied role combining social media, content creation and digital marketing.
- Opportunity to work across large-scale digital and fundraising campaigns.
- Cheadle-based position.

For further information on this opportunity, or any other jobs, please apply via the link below or contact FindCore in the strictest confidence.

title: PPC Manager
description:
PPC Manager

Key points
- Salary £40k-£50k DOE
- Office based role in Stockport
- Onsite 5 days
- Lead ownership of Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta paid media campaigns
- Opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth within a growing eCommerce environment

About the client:

Due to continued growth, we're working with an established and fast-growing organisation that operates a successful eCommerce platform serving both B2 B and B2 C customers.

The business is investing heavily in digital performance and is looking for a hands-on, analytical PPC Manager to take ownership of paid media strategy and execution while identifying opportunities to scale revenue.

The benefits:
- Salary up to £50k depending on experience
- Clear opportunity to own and shape paid media strategy
- Collaborative marketing team environment
- Exposure to large-scale paid media budgets and growth projects
- Opportunity to influence CRO, feed optimisation, and audience strategy

The PPC Manager role:

As PPC Manager, you will take full ownership of all paid advertising activity across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), and Meta.

Working closely with the Head of eCommerce and wider marketing team, you will manage campaign performance, identify growth opportunities, and optimise revenue through careful management of key metrics including CTR, CPC, impression share, and ROAS.

You will also play a key role in Shopping feed optimisation, audience segmentation, and Customer Match strategies, ensuring campaigns align with user lifecycle and intent.

This role suits someone who enjoys deep analysis, structured experimentation, and uncovering performance insights from data while maintaining a strategic view of account growth.

Key areas of focus include:
- Optimising paid search and Shopping campaigns for revenue and ROAS
- Improving CPC efficiency and impression share across non-brand campaigns
- Managing and improving product feeds for Shopping performance
- Developing audience and Customer Match strategies
- Running structured testing across bidding strategies, targeting, and creative
- Collaborating with internal teams to improve landing page performance and CRO
- Reporting insights and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders

PPC Manager essential skills:
- 5+ years experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns
- Experience running Meta Ads campaigns across awareness and conversion objectives
- Strong experience scaling non-brand search and Shopping campaigns
- Deep understanding of bidding strategies, match types, Quality Score, and auction insights
- Experience with product feed optimisation and segmentation
- Knowledge of Customer Match Lists and audience targeting strategies
- Analytical mindset with strong data interpretation skills
- Experience running structured testing and experimentation frameworks

To be considered

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media & Content Marketing Executive

Location: Cheadle
Salary: Up to £45,000
Working Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm

We're partnering with a leading international charity to recruit a Social Media & Content Marketing Executive to join their growing communications team.

This opportunity is ideal for a creative and commercially aware social media professional who can combine engaging content creation with data-driven decision making. You'll be responsible for growing online audiences, increasing engagement across social channels, developing targeted content strategies, and using audience insights to improve supporter journeys and campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and grow social media channels across multiple platforms.
- Create engaging, digital-first content that drives reach, engagement and conversions.
- Build and nurture online communities through effective community management.
- Monitor and analyse performance, providing insight-led recommendations to improve results.
- Develop audience segmentation strategies to deliver more personalised communications.
- Utilise social listening tools to identify trends, opportunities and audience behaviour.
- Support CRM integration activities, including working with Salesforce and social platform data.
- Collaborate with internal teams to support wider communications and fundraising campaigns.
- Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude & Canva AI to support content creation and reporting.

About You
- Experience in a Social Media, Content Marketing or Digital Marketing role.
- Strong understanding of content strategy, audience growth and community engagement.
- Confident using analytics and reporting tools to measure campaign performance.
- Experience with audience segmentation and social listening platforms.
- Knowledge of CRM systems, ideally Salesforce.
- Comfortable using AI-powered marketing tools within day-to-day workflows.
- Excellent communication, copywriting and stakeholder management skills.
- Previous charity, NGO or not-for-profit experience would be advantageous.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to join a mission-led organisation making a genuine global impact.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Exposure to innovative digital marketing strategies and technologies.
- Excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.

Apply now to learn more about this exciting opportunity.
